nodes.label: Agent Approval System (status change requests)
nodes.rationale: Owner cannot change property status without agent approval; property moves to pending until agent decides; owner and agent notified

nodes.label: Security Deposit System
nodes.rationale: Deposit equal to one month rent is reserved in owner wallet at lease signing; released at contract end or deducted for damages; tracked in ms_wallet_restricted_amounts

nodes.label: Smart Owner Invoices (responsible party)
nodes.rationale: If unit has tenant, tenant pays facility management invoices; if vacant/for sale, owner pays

nodes.label: Owner Property Workflow Scenario
nodes.rationale: Owner needs no subscription but must link property to an agent; status restricted to for-rent/for-sale; smart invoices decide who pays facility fees

nodes.label: Tenant Dashboard Fixes (building info, documents tab, contracts)
nodes.norm_label: tenant dashboard fixes (building info, documents tab, contracts)

nodes.label: Agent Subscription System
nodes.rationale: Agents must hold an active package to add properties; on expiry published properties go to draft with prior status saved in meta, restored on renewal

nodes.label: Agent Property Workflow Scenario
nodes.rationale: Login -> package/limit check -> add property -> choose building -> sale/rent -> pick owner/tenant scoped to building -> save Houzez post -> sync unit record -> publish/review

nodes.label: Rented/Sold status requires tenant/buyer and contract
nodes.norm_label: rented/sold status requires tenant/buyer and contract
nodes.rationale: Prevents marking a unit rented/sold without a signed rent or sale contract on file
